description: This file defines a trait called ETagHelperTrait that provides a method to generate an ETag from given data, likely for cache validation purposes within the OrangeHRM core plugin.

classes.name: ETagHelperTrait
classes.description: A trait that provides functionality to generate an ETag string using SHA-256 hashing and Base64 encoding.

methods.name: generateEtag
methods.description: Generates an ETag by hashing the input data with SHA-256 and encoding it with Base64.
